<b>A Vassal Lost</b> is a [[Unique Wishes|Unique Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, given by [[Steel Seer Zi]]. Zi asks [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to track down her missing vassal and retrieve them, alive or dead.

== Starting Location ==
The Wish can be accepted from Steel Seer Zi in the [[Blasted Steps]], who only appears while in [[Steel Soul Mode (Silksong)|Steel Soul Mode]]. Note that Zi will not ask this Wish until [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] has acquired a [[Map and Quill (Silksong)|Map]].

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Steel Seer Zi.png!Steel Seer Zi's location in the Blasted Steps
}}

== Resting Sites ==
To locate the vassal, Steel Seer Zi marks 3 of their "places of rest" for Hornet to visit. The first is picked randomly from the Shellwood, Bone Bottom, and Far Fields locations, which are accessible from Act 1; the second is picked randomly from the Putrified Ducts, High Halls, and Sands of Karak locations, which are only accessible from Act 2; and the third is picked randomly from all six available locations.<ref group=Source name=code>Set by <code>PlayerData.SetupExistingPlayerData()</code> on file creation.</ref>

At each resting spot, Hornet comments on its state and the vassal's actions.

{{HTalk|Whatever the vassal hoped to achieve here seems to have failed. The other marked locations may provide more clues to its intent.}}
| Title1_Event2 = Second location
| Title1_Dialogue2 = {{HTalk|The second spot marked by the child of steel. This camp too was used by their vassal, and another rite was conducted here, this one incomplete.}}<br>

| Title1_Event3 = Final location

{{HTalk|What they attempt is dangerous, stupid. It can only end badly. I must hurry if I'm to stop this.}}
}}

== [[Summoned Saviour]] Fight ==
After visiting all three resting sites, [[Sula]]'s location is marked on the map.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Summoned Saviour 01.png!Sula's location in [[Bonegrave]]
}}

Once Hornet reaches this location, Sula is just finishing their summoning of the [[Summoned Saviour]] as Hornet tries to yell out to stop them. After this, Hornet must defeat Summoned Saviour.

== Reward ==
[[File:Growstone 4.png|link=Growstone|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After defeating Summoned Saviour, Sula despairs at the death of their "champion". Sula expects Hornet to lead them back by needle point to Steel Seer Zi. However, Hornet lets Sula run away. Upon reporting this back to Zi, Zi says that Sula's summoning of the void has marked them to the Masters regardless. Zi then gives Hornet the [[Growstone]].
{{Clear}}
